html.title: KOBOOL - request to buy Contact Points: #$V{invoice}
html.body:
A request to buy KOBOOL points via Vodafone Egypt prepaid card was sent on: $V{date} GMT
Reference Number: $V{invoice}
Card Number: $V{card_number}
Card Value: $V{amount} EGP
 
Note: The points are added manually and could take minutes or couple of hours, depends on purchase time.
Hence, we ask you to have some patience until we add the points.
You should recieve a notification email as soon as we add the points to your account.
Active Member Number: $V{buyer_number}
Login Name: $V{buyer_name}
Beneficiary Member Number: $V{user_number}
Login Name: $V{user_name}

$V{notes}
